note: Language Field provides a language_field field type (default widget languagefield_select, default formatter languagefield_default), two more widgets (languagefield_autocomplete, languagefield_autocomplete_tags), and a custom_language config entity managed at /admin/config/regional/custom_language behind the 'administer languagefield' permission. It has no global settings form (configure=null); all state is per-field storage settings (maxlength, language_range, included_languages, excluded_languages, allowed_values_function) or languagefield.custom_language.<id> config entities. Medium cases read back a field's configured widget and a custom_language entity from the live site; hard cases build a language_field field on Article and a custom_language entity, verified against real config.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module 'Language Field' (languagefield), what is the machine name (plugin id) of the field type it adds so I can store a language value on an entity, and what is its default widget?
evals.expected_output: The field type id is language_field (label 'Language'); its default widget is languagefield_select (a select list) and its default formatter is languagefield_default.

evals.prompt: A languagefield field's storage setting 'language_range' controls which languages are offered. Which value makes the field offer the languagefield module's own custom languages, and which value offers all predefined ISO languages?
evals.expected_output: language_range value 12 offers the module's custom languages (LANGUAGES_CUSTOM); value 11 offers all predefined ISO languages (LANGUAGES_PREDEFINED, the default). Other values: 1 configurable, 2 locked (und/zxx), 3 all core, 4 site default.

evals.prompt: How do I register a language that Drupal does not ship (e.g. a constructed or minority language) so it can be selected in a Language Field, and which permission gates that admin screen?
evals.expected_output: Add a custom_language config entity at /admin/config/regional/custom_language (with id, English label, native_name, direction, weight). The screen is gated by the 'administer languagefield' permission (the route also accepts 'administer languages'). A field then shows it when its language_range includes 12 (custom).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a Language field named field_lf_known. Inspect the live default form display for Article and state which languagefield widget is configured for that field.
evals.expected_output: The field_lf_known component in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default uses the widget type languagefield_autocomplete (the single-value autocomplete widget), not the default languagefield_select.

evals.prompt: This site has a custom language defined through the languagefield module. Inspect the live configuration and give the id of the custom_language config entity and its native name.
evals.expected_output: The custom_language config entity is lf_klingon (config languagefield.custom_language.lf_klingon) with native_name 'tlhIngan Hol' and label 'Klingon'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Language field from the languagefield module to the Article content type. The field machine name must be field_lf_task (entity type node) and it must use the languagefield 'language_field' field type. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A field storage field.storage.node.field_lf_task of type language_field plus a field instance field.field.node.article.field_lf_task exist (create FieldStorageConfig with type language_field, then FieldConfig on bundle article).

evals.prompt: Using the languagefield module, register a new custom language on this site so it can be picked in Language fields. Create a custom_language config entity with id lf_new, English label 'Esperanto' and native name 'Esperanto'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A custom_language config entity with id lf_new (config languagefield.custom_language.lf_new) exists with a non-empty label (create via the custom_language storage or import the YAML).
